messages:
alex: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups for last night's canary regression. Need clear owners + dates for blast-radius controls and an auto-rollback prototype. TL;DR: incident exposed two gaps: (1) no automated rollback trigger, (2) feature flags are too coarse for regional rollouts.

maria: copying notes into the postmortem tracker now. I sketched a short PRD. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGINF-666 :spiral_calendar:

jin-ops: I can take the auto-rollback prototype. Question: what exact signals should trigger rollback? error rate only, or latency + correctness checks?

alex: prefer a composite rule: primary = error-rate spike (>=3x baseline for 5m), fallback = p99 latency > 2s sustained 5m, plus optional output-regression signal from eval webhook. If any of these happen AND rollback confidence score > 0.7 then initiate.

sarah-p: I'll own flag granularity & UI gating. Proposal: per-flag metadata: {region, cohort, max_percentage, service_selector}. Support hierarchical scoping (org -> service -> region).

maria: added an action item list in the tracker with owners. I'll own coordination and E2E testing plan. Due dates proposed below.

jin-ops: technical notes — to reduce false positives we should require at least two independent signals (errors+latency OR errors+eval). Also need a 1-hr cooldown for auto-rollback to avoid flip-flopping.

alex: agree on two-signal rule. Add manual override in Console and API. Also include a "dry-run" mode that logs what would happen.

eng-oncall: recurring pattern note: we've seen repeated canary flaps tied to cold KV cache and model warmup mismatch. Fixes: prefix-aware KV warming, stricter cache warming checks before traffic ramp. Owner: jin-ops.

maria: timeline proposal: prototype auto-rollback (POC + tests) by 2026-04-07; flag granularity changes + Console UX by 2026-04-14; systemwide rollout and runbook update by 2026-04-28. Thoughts? :calendar:

jin-ops: acked. I'll try to get POC by 04-07. Will need 3 days of focused time and 2 reviewers for safety checks.

sarah-p: UX mockups ready by 04-09, OK to pair with maria for the tracker entries.

maria: mitigation in short term: add a per-rollout max-blast-radius limit (default 10% traffic, 1 region) and circuit-breaker that automatically pauses ramp at anomalous metrics. I'll push a config flag today: `max_blast_radius: 0.1`

alex: good. also add telemetry events for every automatic decision so we can audit why a rollback happened: `rollback_decision.{signal,score,owner,run_id}`

deploy-bot: deploy status: canary ramp paused by eng-oncall at 1819001500 due to p99 spike.

eng-oncall: noted. We paused to give ops a chance to warm caches; that prevented further user impact. Adding this to the incident timeline.

maria: action items (short):
- ENGINF-666: Auto-rollback POC — owner: jin-ops — due: 2026-04-07
- ENGINF-667: Flag granularity + Console UX — owner: sarah-p — due: 2026-04-14
- ENGINF-668: Blast-radius limits & circuit-breaker — owner: maria — due: 2026-03-31 (hotfix)
- ENGINF-669: KV warmup & cache checks — owner: jin-ops — due: 2026-04-10
- ENGINF-670: Runbook update + telemetry schema — owner: alex — due: 2026-04-21

alex: prioritize ENGINF-668 as hotfix. jin-ops, can you sketch the rollback decision schema in `rollback_policy.yaml` in a PR? Example: 

```
# rollback_policy.yaml (minimal)
signals:
  - name: error_rate
    threshold: 3.0  # multiplier vs baseline
    window: 300     # seconds
  - name: p99_latency
    threshold_ms: 2000
    window: 300
require_two_signals: true
cooldown_seconds: 3600
dry_run: true
```

jin-ops: will open PR today and link to ENGINF-666. I'll include unit tests that simulate noisy metrics.

sarah-p: for rollout UI, let's add a quick toggle "Allow auto-rollback" per-flag and show recent rollback reasons in the flag history.

maria: I'll schedule a 30-min sync next Tue to review POC + UX — invite: @jin-ops @sarah-p @alex.

alex: thanks all. Final ask: please update the tracker with weekly progress until closed. If anyone hits blockers ping in #eng-platform or @maria directly. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: meeting created: "Auto-rollback & Blast-radius sync" Tue 2026-03-31 16:00 UTC.

eng-oncall: noted and adding a final note to the postmortem: enforce hotfix for blast-radius config as immediate mitigation.

maria: closing thread notes here — will convert to checklist in tracker and assign notifications.
